name: John Sherburne
bio: a Representative from New Hampshire; born in Portsmouth, N.H., in 1757; graduated from Dartmouth College, Hanover, N.H., in 1776 and from the law department of Harvard University; admitted to the bar and commenced practice in Portsmouth, N.H., in 1776; served in the Revolutionary War and attained the rank of major in the Continental Army; elected as an Anti-Administration candidate to the Third Congress and reelected as a Democratic Republican to the Fourth Congress (March 4, 1793-March 3, 1797); United States district attorney for New Hampshire, 1801-1804; appointed judge of the United States District Court for the District of New Hampshire and served from May 1804 until his death in Portsmouth, N.H., August 2, 1830.
